title: Answer: compute causation across scales of real systems

statements.text: Causal emergence is checked by computing EI or the causal primitives across coarse-grains of measured systems: neurons against neuronal groups against brain regions using optogenetics and calcium imaging, gene regulatory networks, and protein interactomes.

sources.quote: In real neural systems, one could compare the respective effective information at the micro scale of single neurons over millisecond intervals, the meso scale of neuronal groups over hundreds of milliseconds
